items.reason: The float-based main topic title still retains its bullet margin at app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic.scss:10-13. The removed margin belongs to the header, where the category renders below the heading (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/header-extra-info.hbs:13-15), and the PR changes both header alignment and line-height; removing that spacing does not establish the claimed alignment defect.

app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:264 makes the description a flex item, but its rule at line 279 supplies neither growth nor a width. The buttons are nested inside that description (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/small-action.hbs:2-8) and float right at topic-post.scss:309, so short descriptions leave the controls short of the row’s right edge.

app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:520-521 still pulls custom messages 40px left, into the adjacent icon’s horizontal space. The new flex alignment centers that icon against the entire description, including its custom message (app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:264-265; app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/small-action.hbs:15-16), allowing longer messages to overlap the icon.
